scope: Engineering QA; synthetic events plus published frozen model parameters on synthetic states; no private observation data, val or test read. Synthetic optimizer updates are test fixtures, not research fits.
command_suffix: -m pytest -q tests/test_closure_training_runtime.py tests/test_train_closure.py tests/test_symbolic_closure_rom.py tests/test_symbolic_compile.py tests/test_confirmation_components.py
tests_cover: discover_closure.loss values, terms and all trainable gradients
nonzero seeded coefficients and legal direction groups
real interval counts including varying event lengths
generic node p^2*q^2 and tanh(2q) fallback
four published physical parameter packages: field and Jacobian
graph cache cleared by backward scope, device or state change
portable JSON export without moving live model
two synthetic optimizer updates: uninterrupted vs exact checkpoint resume on CPU and CUDA
CPU-to-CUDA Adam moment migration with explicit environment-change guard
checkpoint export and pointer publication interruptions
before-update, Adam and post-publication interruptions with correct rollback accounting
